summary: Six-phase plan for the advisory ROADMAP batch-proposal lint, built on the research report's settled LIVE SEAM 1 call site. Phase 1 performs territory hygiene (drops the dead commands/review.md entry, adds serializing edges onto the roadmap-format.md and conclusion-stage.md claimants); Phases 2-3 build the script (layout sniff, authored-Run-line parse stopping at the generated coverage appendix, findings c/d/f, then finding a via a single spliced jq program); Phase 4 adds the fixture suite and manifest registration; Phase 5 lands finding (e), the Step 5 call site, and the two documentation pointers; Phase 6 deploys and runs the complete gate set.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 8.25-hour plan for an advisory lint over hand-authored /orchestrate batch proposals in specs/ROADMAP.md, wired into the /orchestrate conclusion stage.

memory_candidates.content: In the agent-system source store, specs/ROADMAP.md's `## Next` fenced block mixes HAND-AUTHORED /orchestrate Run lines with MACHINE-GENERATED ones: everything below the `**Coverage appendix (uncovered tasks)**:` header is rendered by roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate, not typed by anyone. Measured live: 20 /orchestrate lines total, 11 authored above the header, 9 generated below it. Any tool that reads batch proposals as authored intent must stop parsing at that header, or it lints its own generator's output.
